title: Create Music Group Acquires Minority Stake in DistroKid
summary: The acquisition is the latest in Create's recent string of investments in the indie space.
body: Create Music Group has acquired a minority stake in DistroKid, Billboard can confirm. The deal, which went down earlier this year, comes several months after CVC Capital Partners announced it had acquired a majority stake in the DIY distribution platform. That agreement was announced in July; while no terms were disclosed, MBW reported in January that DistroKid was exploring a sale at a valuation of roughly $2 billion. MBW was also first to report the Create deal. title: NASA Welcomes Vietnam as Newest Artemis Accords Signatory
summary: The Socialist Republic of Vietnam became the 78th nation to sign the Artemis Accords, joining a growing coalition of like-minded nations committed to the peaceful, transparent, and responsible exploration of space. “Vietnam is joining at an important point in the development of its own space progra…
body: Credit: NASA The Socialist Republic of Vietnam became the 78th nation to sign the Artemis Accords, joining a growing coalition of like-minded nations committed to the peaceful, transparent, and responsible exploration of space.   “Vietnam is joining at an important point in the development of its own space program,” said NASA Deputy Administrator Matt Anderson in recorded remarks for the ceremony. “NASA and the Vietnam National Space Center have built momentum in satellite innovation, land-use research, and radar-based Earth observation. Joining the Artemis Accords opens a new chapter in that relationship. We’ve aligned on the principles. The opportunities are in front of us, and now we can build on that foundation together. We are proud to welcome Vietnam to the Artemis Accords community.”  Vietnam’s Minister of Science and Technology Vũ Hải Quân signed the Artemis Accords on behalf of the country during the Vietnam International Digital Week in Ha Long. The United States Ambassador to Vietnam Jennifer Wicks also participated in the signing event. Vietnam’s decision extends the U.S.-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership into a new frontier. body: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 October 28 – The… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video Michael Wong The Mutual Occultation of Ganymede and Io Explanation: Jupiter is one of the least lonely planets in the Solar System, at least when it comes to natural satellites . 115 moons have been discovered orbiting Jupiter so far! ( Saturn has the most with 293, but who’s counting . ) Ganymede and Io , two of Jupiter’s Galilean moons , met in the sky on October 20th, 2026. Today’s video captures the meeting, with Ganymede briefly blocking Io from view. This event, when an astronomical object passes in front of another and either completely or partially blocks it, is called a mutual occultation.
